title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: What a Completed Callout Consumes
content:
A completed callout under a Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan consumes one credit whatever the service
given, so a tow and a jump start each cost one callout, and a callout with no credit left is charged at
the plan's additional callout price instead of being refused.

Where the vehicle was on a marketplace trip when it failed, the trip is dealt with under the trip rules
and the callout under these, and neither decides the other.

### Points of basis

**What does a completed callout draw from the allowance?** One callout, whatever assistance was given.
A tow and a jump start each cost one callout; the allowance is not measured in the value or the length
of the work done.

**What happens where no credit is left?** The callout is charged at the plan's additional callout
price. It is not refused for want of an allowance.

**Where the vehicle was out on a marketplace trip when it failed, does the trip govern the callout?**
No. The trip is dealt with under the marketplace's trip rules and the callout under the Keyturn
Roadside Assistance rules, and neither of the two decides the other.
